# Copilot PRDs — external design-review input (NON-CANONICAL)

**Provenance.** These 11 PRDs were generated by **Microsoft Copilot** on
**2026-07-19**, after it reviewed the project's architecture and design docs.
Supplied by May. They are stored here **verbatim** as external-review input —
they are *not* project specifications and nothing here is committed.

## ⚠️ Unit IDs and ADR numbers here are NON-CANONICAL

The unit IDs (e.g. `O14`, `O15`, `O16`, `O17`, `S12`, `W1`) and ADR numbers
(e.g. `0018`–`0021`) that appear inside these PRDs are **invented by the
generating model**. They **collide** with each other and with the real
registries. Do not treat any ID in these files as authoritative. In particular:

- `slice-4`'s `O14` collides with the real **O14 (session chrome)**.
- `slice-10` calls the policy editor "unit B8" — the real **B8 is the
  audit-trail explorer**.
- Statutory citations and override-hour values inside these PRDs are
  self-described approximations and are **UNVERIFIED** (possibly apocryphal).

**Canonical registries:**
- UI units / gaps: [`docs/design/ui-unit-exploration.md`](../../ui-unit-exploration.md)
- ADRs: [`docs/architecture/adr/README.md`](../../../architecture/adr/README.md)

## Dispositions

Per-PRD dispositions (adopt / record / discard, with corrections and blockers)
are recorded in the authoritative decision record:
[`docs/design/external-review-triage.md`](../../external-review-triage.md).

## Note on the file set

There were originally **12** files in the source folder:
`prd-slice2-assignment-notifications-g4.txt` and
`prd-slice2-assignment-notifications-g4 (1).txt` were **byte-identical
duplicates** — a single copy is kept here under the clean name.
